description: Configuring and running Pipeline Inspection in Sales Cloud: enabling the feature, mapping forecast categories into the inspection view, Days in Stage and other deal-change metrics, and pipeline review cadence for sales managers. Use when designing or improving how a team monitors deal health and pipeline movement. NOT for the Revenue Intelligence app, Einstein deal insights, or forecast-accuracy dashboards — use admin/revenue-intelligence-setup. NOT for forecast types, quotas, or forecast hierarchy setup — use admin/collaborative-forecasts. Keywords: pipeline review, coverage ratio, stage conversion, slippage, stale deals, days in stage, LastStageChangeInDays, LastStageChangeDate, AgeInDays, PushCount, ForecastCategoryName, enablePipelineInspection, PipelineInspMetricConfig, OpportunitySettings, review cadence, commit call.
inputs: Whether the org has Revenue Intelligence, Sales Cloud Einstein, or neither
List of forecast types and their source objects (Opportunity, Opportunity Splits)
Which metrics the sales team prioritizes (e.g., Days in Stage, amount changes, stage changes)
Desired pipeline review cadence (weekly, bi-weekly, etc.) and who participates
Current Stage picklist values and their ForecastCategoryName mappings
name: pipeline-review-design
official_sources: **Object Reference (Summer '26 / v62), Opportunity standard object** — the field-level grounding for every metric in `references/worked-examples.md` §2: `AgeInDays` (192275–192282), `Amount` and its product-bearing update behaviour (192284–192292), `CloseDate` (192320–192326), `ExpectedRevenue` (192401–192408), `ForecastCategory` vs `ForecastCategoryName` value sets (192452–192497), `IsClosed` / `IsWon` (192553–192630), `LastStageChangeDate` / `LastStageChangeInDays` (192707–192724), `NextStep` (192758–192764), `Probability` (192851–192862), `PushCount` (192865–192873), `StageName` (192893–192904). https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf

**Metadata API Developer Guide (Summer '26 / v62), `Report`** — the deployable report shape in `references/worked-examples.md` §4: `ReportColumn` (104561–104580), `ReportFilter` / `ReportFilterItem` and the `FilterOperation` enum (104595–104660), `ReportBucketField` and the `BucketField_` naming requirement (104295–104330), `ReportTimeFrameFilter` (105096–105110), the `UserDateInterval` fiscal-vs-calendar split behind gotcha 10 (105164, 105226), the sample definitions the column codes are read off (105312–105500, 105510–105690), and the package.xml folder rules behind gotcha 12 (103882–103943). https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

**Metadata API Developer Guide, `Dashboard`** — the required-element list, `dashboardType` semantics including `MyTeamUser`, and `DashboardFilterColumn.column` behind `references/worked-examples.md` §5 (47641, 47684–47700, 47790–47800, 47823–47866, 47989, 48317). Same PDF as above.

**Metadata API Developer Guide, `ListView`** — `filterScope` and its enum, `ListViewFilter`, the column-token warning, and the `filter`-vs-`field` element discrepancy behind gotcha 11 (44317–44319, 44374, 44385–44400, 44409–44448, 44468–44478, 44501–44503). Same PDF as above.

**`skills/admin/reports-and-dashboards`, `references/metadata-examples.md` and `references/gotchas.md`** — the canonical Report / Dashboard / folder metadata reference this skill cites rather than duplicates: folder `accessType`, running-user semantics, subscription behaviour, and the report-column-code trap.
**`skills/admin/list-views-and-compact-layouts`, `references/gotchas.md`** — the list-view column-token and `sharedTo` behaviour the stale-deals view in `references/worked-examples.md` §6 depends on.

**`skills/admin/opportunity-management`, `references/gotchas.md` Gotchas 9, 12 and 13** — stage-change overwrite, what `OpportunityHistory` actually records, and the two forecast-category vocabularies; the stage-conversion metric rests on all three.
**`skills/admin/sales-process-mapping`, `references/gotchas.md` Gotcha 3** — bulk and mass-close paths bypass the hygiene enforcement the review depends on.

**`agents/sales-stage-designer/AGENT.md`, Mandatory Reads** — the run-time consumer of this skill's metric-to-field mapping; it reads this package so the stage ladder it designs produces measurable movement.

Pipeline Inspection Metrics and Fields — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.pipeline_inspection_metrics_fields.htm&type=5 (supports the pre-existing enablement, metric-configuration and lookback-window statements in SKILL.md; not fetchable from this environment)

Guidelines and Limits for Pipeline Inspection — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.pipeline_inspection_guidelines_and_limits.htm&type=5 (supports the licensing prerequisite and the forecast-hierarchy visibility rule)
Customize Pipeline Forecast Categories — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.forecasts3_pipeline_forecast_categories.htm&type=5 (supports the custom-forecast-category statements)
Collaborative Forecasts Implementation Guide — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.forecasts3_implement.htm&type=5 (supports the forecast-type association prerequisite)
